changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Repoint stock_holdings at one canonical stock_types row per distinct name, ahead of dropping the per-user duplicates
changeSet.sql: UPDATE finances.stock_holdings sh SET stock_type_id = canonical.canonical_id FROM finances.stock_types st JOIN ( SELECT name, MIN(id) AS canonical_id FROM finances.stock_types GROUP BY name ) canonical ON canonical.name = st.name WHERE sh.stock_type_id = st.id AND st.id <> canonical.canonical_id;

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Drop the now-unreferenced per-user duplicate stock_types rows, keeping one row per name
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM finances.stock_types st USING ( SELECT name, MIN(id) AS canonical_id FROM finances.stock_types GROUP BY name ) canonical WHERE st.name = canonical.name AND st.id <> canonical.canonical_id;

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: stock_types becomes a global list: drop user_id, replace the per-user unique constraint with a global one on name

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE finances.stock_types DROP CONSTRAINT stock_types_name_key; ALTER TABLE finances.stock_types ADD COLUMN user_id BIGINT REFERENCES system.users(id);
